chosen_decisions.decision: Split into declaration block (B1) and combinational lookup block (B2).
chosen_decisions.reason: Aligns with spec's explicit separation of interface/LUT definition and immediate combinational response. Keeps retrieval focused on constants vs. logic.

deferred_decisions: exact Verilog construct for LUT population (packed array initialization vs. exhaustive enumeration)
whether to hardcode all 256 values inline or use a generation-time macro
structural_risks: large constant arrays may require careful formatting to avoid tool parsing limits
single combinational path may have high fan-in if implemented as a massive enumeration; structure allows alternative array indexing to mitigate
behavioral_risks: incomplete LUT coverage could infer latches; B2 must explicitly cover all 256 values or use complete array indexing
timing closure on critical path when instantiated 16 times in parallel in top module; skeleton assumes combinational delay is acceptable per spec Sec 6
